tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this to find Johnson Bros. Plumbing pages about services, service area, pricing policy, or common questions. Returns ids, titles and URLs only -- call fetch with an id to read the full text. Do not use it to check live appointment availability (use get_availability) or to look up a customer.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this to read the full text of a document returned by search. Takes the exact id from a search result. Returns public business information only -- it never returns customer records.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, open_customer_portal, get_services_pricing, search · Private data: open_customer_portal, search_service_history, submit_customer_info, check_service_area, business_info, request_callback, request_booking, confirm_booking, fetch · Public sink: get_quote, open_customer_portal, search_service_history, submit_customer_info, request_callback, request_booking, confirm_booking · Destructive: check_service_area.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, open_customer_portal, get_services_pricing, search · Private data: open_customer_portal, search_service_history, submit_customer_info, check_service_area, business_info, request_callback, request_booking, confirm_booking, fetch · Public sink: get_quote, open_customer_portal, search_service_history, submit_customer_info, request_callback, request_booking, confirm_booking · Destructive: check_service_area

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
